title: A two-page spread sharing a master
concept: Two pages in one spread, each applying the same master by its Self id.

annotations.note: PageCount=2 and BindingLocation=1: two pages, with the spine after the first. InDesign needs both to open the spread as written.
The left page. Page items use spread coordinates with the spine at x = 0, so this page's ItemTransform moves it to x = -595.276 … 0. Its frame below sits at negative x.
Both pages carry AppliedMaster="umaster": the master's Self id, not its part path.
The right page starts at the spine. This file keeps the page tops at y = 0; InDesign's own exports shift both pages up by half the page height, which the spread-coordinates example shows.
